correctness.rationale: For sorted four role counts, positive individually rational partitions are precisely 2-, 3- and 4-member transversals. The Gale-Ryser inequalities for the four row degrees and 2/3/4 column degrees reduce exactly to a<=p+t+q and q<=d. Every feasible spectrum with q<min(d,floor((n-2a)/2)) admits a strict product-improving quartet addition, by replacing two triples with a quartet and pair (factor 81/64), or two pairs with a quartet (factor 81). This forces q*, then maximizing the remaining feasible t determines a unique spectrum. Elementary-symmetric coefficient extraction counts labeled partitions exactly. Verified with exact exhaustive checks of 730 size profiles and 30 labeled-count profiles, plus 2000 seeded constructive instances. Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 primary paper defines enemy-averse Nash welfare, gives general clique characterization, hardness/approximations, and a local 4+2 versus 3+3 example, but no full exact four-role class-size formula or tied-optimizer count in inspected sections and appendix. The 2025 multipartite literature optimizes utilitarian, not Nash, welfare. The earlier exact three-role boundary covers d=0 only. The four-positive-role quartet cap and all-size optimal-spectrum/count classification are not implied by those results. A bounded search and inspection cannot rule out all unindexed equivalents.

value.rationale: The fixed four-partite friendship family is a natural structured class at the boundary of general NP-hard enemy-averse Nash welfare. Four roles introduce genuinely competing quartets and triples, unlike the previously solved three-role family. The result completely classifies positive welfare, the forced optimal team-size spectrum and the exact labeled optimizer count, enabling finite-population fair tie-breaking. Example (5,4,4,1) gives a genuine strict product improvement 5184 over no-quartet 4096, with 34560 optimal labeled partitions.
